name: Audiomat
_terms_read_and_they_do_not_forbid_it: audiomat.fr read 2026-11-27 with curl. No robots.txt (the IIS host answers 404). No terms of use, legal notice or copyright line on the home page, the product list or the product pages - the site's only menu entries are Produits, Conseils d'utilisation, Qui sommes-nous ?, Contactez-nous and Points d'écoute. So there is no prohibition to honour; the standing rule asks for an explicit one. The catalogue stores no images and no logos.
_the_site_lists_converters_and_history_s: The maker's own product list (« Produits ») puts four models under « Convertisseurs » - Tempo C, Tempo 2.8, Maestro 3, Maestro 3 référence - and keeps older ones under « Historique », of which Tempo 2.7 and Tempo 3 are converters. The « Drive D1 » under « Source » is a CD transport with no conversion stage and has no record here.
